introHtml:
Marketing directors planning a trade show giveaway need a high-impact item that attendees will actually keep. HR directors assembling employee onboarding kits want something useful that reinforces company culture. Safety managers distributing field equipment require durable cases that protect devices on the job. Custom phone and tablet cases fit every scenario: they offer daily utility, constant brand visibility, and real protection.

Perfect Imprints stocks a wide range of styles, from rugged neoprene sleeves to elegant leather portfolios. Options like the Cowhide Tablet Portfolio project a premium image for executive gifts, while the Floating Water-Resistant Smartphone Pouch is ideal for outdoor teams or events near water. PopSockets PopWallet Plus Lite adds grip and card storage in one. Whatever your use case, you can customize each case with your logo, artwork, or message.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom phone tablet cases, start by considering the primary use case. A case for a corporate giveaway should balance aesthetics and durability, while one for construction site workers must prioritize ruggedness and drop protection. The Cowhide Tablet Portfolio, for example, offers a professional leather finish for client meetings, whereas a silicone bumper case suits everyday employee use. Matching the case style to your audience ensures the item gets used and keeps your brand visible.

Materials and Build Quality

Materials range from soft silicone and TPU to hard polycarbonate, neoprene, and genuine leather. Silicone cases provide shock absorption and a secure grip, while polycarbonate backs resist scratches. Neoprene sleeves like the Floating Water-Resistant Pouch offer water resistance and a soft interior. For premium feel, leather portfolios convey sophistication. Always check that the case fits the exact device model and provides easy access to ports and buttons.

Decoration Options

Screen printing works well on flat silicone or hard plastic cases for simple logos. Full-color heat transfer or sublimation is ideal for neoprene sleeves and allows photographic detail. For leather cases, debossing or foil stamping creates an elegant, permanent mark. Pad printing suits small, intricate designs on curved surfaces. Consider the case material and surface area when choosing a decoration method; some materials require pretreatment for ink adhesion.

Common Use Cases

Trade shows and conferences benefit from promotional phone cases because attendees use them daily, providing repeated brand impressions. Employee onboarding kits with branded cases show new hires they are valued. Safety managers can distribute rugged cases to field workers to protect company devices. Customer appreciation gifts with personalized cases strengthen loyalty. Bulk orders for events like charity runs or school fundraisers also work well.

Quantity and Pricing

Minimum order quantities for custom phone tablet cases typically start at 50 to 100 units, with lower per-unit costs at higher volumes. For small runs under 250, screen printing or pad printing keeps costs down. For orders of 500 or more, full-color heat transfer becomes economical. Wholesale pricing is available for larger quantities. Plan ahead: production time averages 10–15 business days after artwork approval, plus shipping.

Avoiding Common Mistakes

One frequent error is ordering cases without verifying device compatibility. Always confirm the exact model and generation. Another mistake is choosing a decoration method that doesn't adhere well to the case material; ask your account manager for a sample. Also, avoid overly complex artwork on small cases, as fine details may blur. Finally, order extras for replacements and future needs, as reordering the same design may have different pricing.
buyingGuideH2: Custom Phone & Tablet Cases Buying Guide

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom phone cases?
faqs.a: Minimums typically start at 50 units for screen-printed cases and 100 for full-color sublimation. Some styles may have higher MOQs. Contact us for specific product requirements.

faqs.q: Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer sample orders. You can request a blank sample to check fit and feel, or a decorated sample with your logo for a small additional fee.

faqs.q: What decoration methods work best for phone cases?
faqs.a: Screen printing is cost-effective for simple logos on flat surfaces. Full-color heat transfer or sublimation works well on neoprene or fabric cases. For leather, debossing or foil stamping gives a premium look.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom cases?
faqs.a: Standard production is 10-15 business days after artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Shipping time depends on the method chosen.

faqs.q: Do you offer cases for all phone and tablet models?
faqs.a: We stock cases for popular models from Apple, Samsung, Google, and others. If you need a specific model, check our product pages or contact us to confirm availability.
